SALES BU - Quarter - End */  UNION ALL  /* Dim Based - SALES BU - Month - Begin */  SELECT         '01'                              AS calendar_type,        'SALES BU'                        AS driving_dim_code,         tl.business_unit_name             AS dimension_value,            TO_CHAR(tl.business_unit_id)  dimension_value_code,        'Month'                           AS time_level,        time_seq                          AS time_seq,        time_value                        AS time_value,        time_seq + no_of_periods          AS yago_time_seq   FROM             (       SELECT DISTINCT                l.ledger_name                    ,                a.fiscal_trailing_period_number     AS time_seq,               a.fiscal_period_name                AS time_value,               a.fiscal_period_set_name            AS fiscal_period_set_name           FROM               dw_fiscal_period_d a,               dw_ledger_d   l         WHERE               (a.fiscal_trailing_period_number BETWEEN 0 and 19 OR a.fiscal_trailing_period_number IN (52,53))           AND a.fiscal_period_set_name = l.ledger_calender_name           AND a.adjustment_period_flag = 'N'       ) x,       dw_business_unit_d A,       dw_business_unit_d_tl tl,       (         select fiscal_period_set_name,max(no_of_periods) as no_of_periods            from (             select fiscal_period_set_name,fiscal_year_number,count(distinct fiscal_period_name) as no_of_periods               from dw_fiscal_period_d              where adjustment_period_flag = 'N'              group by fiscal_period_set_name,fiscal_year_number              order by fiscal_period_set_name,fiscal_year_number            )            group by fiscal_period_set_name       ) m2       WHERE       a.business_unit_id = tl.business_unit_id   AND tl.language = 'VALUEOF(NQ_SESSION.USER_LANGUAGE_CODE)'   AND a.primary_ledger = x.ledger_name   AND x.fiscal_period_set_name = m2.fiscal_period_set_name  /* Dim Based - SALES BU - Month End */

nodes.id: SELECT DISTINCT        '01'                              AS calendar_type,        'SUBSIDIARY'                          AS driving_dim_code,        s.name                     AS dimension_value,            TO_CHAR(s.id)         dimension_value_code,        'Year' AS time_level,            SUM(1)OVER(PARTITION BY s.name,b.fiscal_period_set_name ORDER BY b.fiscal_year_number DESC)-1 AS time_seq,        TO_CHAR(b.fiscal_year_name) AS time_value,         SUM(1)OVER(PARTITION BY s.name,b.fiscal_period_set_name ORDER BY b.fiscal_year_number DESC)-1+1 AS yago_time_seq  FROM       dw_ns_subsidiary_D s,       (select distinct  fiscalcalendar fiscal_period_set_name, top_periodname fiscal_year_name,  to_number(to_char(top_startdate,'yyyy')) fiscal_year_number,  top_startdate year_start_date,  top_enddate year_end_date,  case when trunc(sysdate) between top_startdate and top_enddate then 'Current' else null end current_fiscal_year_code from DW_NS_FISCALCALPERIOD_DH ) a, (select distinct  fiscalcalendar fiscal_period_set_name, top_periodname fiscal_year_name,  to_number(to_char(top_startdate,'yyyy')) fiscal_year_number,  top_startdate year_start_date,  top_enddate year_end_date,  case when trunc(sysdate) between top_startdate and top_enddate then 'Current' else null end current_fiscal_year_code from DW_NS_FISCALCALPERIOD_DH ) b  where a.fiscal_period_set_name=s.fiscalcalendar and a.fiscal_period_set_name = b.fiscal_period_set_name and a.current_fiscal_year_code = 'Current' AND b.fiscal_year_number BETWEEN a.fiscal_year_number - 19 AND a.fiscal_year_number UNION SELECT DISTINCT        '01'                              AS calendar_type,        'SUBSIDIARY'                          AS driving_dim_code,        s.name                     AS dimension_value,           TO_CHAR(s.id)         dimension_value_code,        'Quarter' AS time_level,   SUM(1)OVER(PARTITION BY s.name,b.fiscal_period_set_name ORDER BY b.runcount DESC)-1 AS time_seq, TO_CHAR(b.fiscal_quarter_name) AS time_value, SUM(1)OVER(PARTITION BY s.name,b.fiscal_period_set_name ORDER BY b.runcount DESC)-1+4 AS yago_time_seq from dw_ns_subsidiary_d s, (select fiscal_period_set_name, fiscal_quarter_name, current_fiscal_quarter_code, COUNT(1)OVER(PARTITION BY fiscal_period_set_name ORDER BY fiscal_period_set_name,quarter_start_date,quarter_end_date) runcount from (select distinct  fiscalcalendar fiscal_period_set_name, level1_periodname fiscal_quarter_name,  level1_startdate quarter_start_date,  level1_enddate quarter_end_date,  case when trunc(sysdate) between level1_startdate and level1_enddate then 'Current' else null end current_fiscal_quarter_code from DW_NS_FISCALCALPERIOD_DH ) ) a, (select fiscal_period_set_name, fiscal_quarter_name, current_fiscal_quarter_code, COUNT(1)OVER(PARTITION BY fiscal_period_set_name ORDER BY fiscal_period_set_name,quarter_start_date,quarter_end_date) runcount from (select distinct  fiscalcalendar fiscal_period_set_name, level1_periodname fiscal_quarter_name,  level1_startdate quarter_start_date,  level1_enddate quarter_end_date,  case when trunc(sysdate) between level1_startdate and level1_enddate then 'Current' else null end current_fiscal_quarter_code from DW_NS_FISCALCALPERIOD_DH ) ) b  where a.fiscal_period_set_name=s.fiscalcalendar and a.fiscal_period_set_name = b.fiscal_period_set_name and a.current_fiscal_quarter_code = 'Current' AND b.runcount BETWEEN a.runcount - 19 AND a.runcount UNION SELECT DISTINCT        '01'                              AS calendar_type,        'SUBSIDIARY'                          AS driving_dim_code,        s.name                     AS dimension_value,        TO_CHAR(s.id)         dimension_value_code,            'Month' AS time_level,   SUM(1)OVER(PARTITION BY s.name,b.fiscal_period_set_name ORDER BY b.runcount DESC)-1 AS time_seq, TO_CHAR(b.fiscal_month_name) AS time_value, SUM(1)OVER(PARTITION BY s.name,b.fiscal_period_set_name ORDER BY b.runcount DESC)-1+12 AS yago_time_seq from dw_ns_subsidiary_d s, (select fiscal_period_set_name, fiscal_month_name, current_fiscal_month_code, COUNT(1)OVER(PARTITION BY fiscal_period_set_name ORDER BY fiscal_period_set_name,month_start_date,month_end_date) runcount from (select distinct  fiscalcalendar fiscal_period_set_name, level2_periodname fiscal_month_name,  level2_startdate month_start_date,  level2_enddate month_end_date,  case when trunc(sysdate) between level2_startdate and level2_enddate then 'Current' else null end current_fiscal_month_code from DW_NS_FISCALCALPERIOD_DH ) ) a, (select fiscal_period_set_name, fiscal_month_name, current_fiscal_month_code, COUNT(1)OVER(PARTITION BY fiscal_period_set_name ORDER BY fiscal_period_set_name,month_start_date,month_end_date) runcount from (select distinct  fiscalcalendar fiscal_period_set_name, level2_periodname fiscal_month_name,  level2_startdate month_start_date,  level2_enddate month_end_date,  case when trunc(sysdate) between level2_startdate and level2_enddate then 'Current' else null end current_fiscal_month_code from DW_NS_FISCALCALPERIOD_DH ) ) b  where a.fiscal_period_set_name=s.fiscalcalendar and a.fiscal_period_set_name = b.fiscal_period_set_name and a.current_fiscal_month_code = 'Current' AND b.runcount BETWEEN a.runcount - 19 AND a.runcount

edges.source: /* Dim Based - Ledger - Year - Begin */  SELECT DISTINCT        '01'                              AS calendar_type,        'LEDGER'                          AS driving_dim_code,        l.ledger_name                     AS dimension_value,            TO_CHAR(l.ledger_id)         dimension_value_code,        'Year'                            AS time_level,            a.fiscal_trailing_year_number     AS time_seq,        TO_CHAR(a.fiscal_year_number)     AS time_value,        a.fiscal_trailing_year_number + 1 AS yago_time_seq  FROM       dw_fiscal_year_d a,       dw_ledger_d l WHERE       a.fiscal_trailing_year_number BETWEEN 0 and 19   AND a.fiscal_period_set_name = l.ledger_calender_name  /* Dim Based - Ledger - Year - End */        UNION ALL  /* Dim Based - Ledger - Quarter - Begin */  SELECT DISTINCT        '01'                               AS calendar_type,        'LEDGER'                           AS driving_dim_code,        l.ledger_name                      AS dimension_value,        TO_CHAR(l.ledger_id)         dimension_value_code,            'Quarter'                          AS time_level,        a.fiscal_trailing_quarter_number   AS time_seq,        a.fiscal_quarter_code              AS time_value,        a.fiscal_trailing_quarter_number + 4 AS yago_time_seq          FROM        dw_fiscal_quarter_d a,        dw_ledger_d l  WHERE        a.fiscal_trailing_quarter_number BETWEEN 0 and 19    AND a.fiscal_period_set_name = l.ledger_calender_name   /* Dim Based - Ledger - Quarter - End */  UNION ALL  /* Dim Based - Ledger - Month - Begin */ SELECT calendar_type,            driving_dim_code,        dimension_value,            dimension_value_code,        time_level,        time_seq,        time_value,        time_seq + m2.no_of_periods AS yago_time_seq FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT         '01'                              AS calendar_type,        'LEDGER'                          AS driving_dim_code,        l.ledger_name                     AS dimension_value,            TO_CHAR(l.ledger_id)              AS dimension_value_code,        'Month'                           AS time_level,        a.fiscal_trailing_period_number   AS time_seq,        a.fiscal_period_name              AS time_value,        a.fiscal_period_set_name          AS fiscal_period_set_name   FROM        dw_fiscal_period_d a,        dw_ledger_d l  WHERE adjustment_period_flag = 'N'    AND (a.fiscal_trailing_period_number BETWEEN 0 and 19 OR a.fiscal_trailing_period_number IN (52,53))    AND a.fiscal_period_set_name = l.ledger_calender_name ) m1, ( select fiscal_period_set_name,max(no_of_periods) as no_of_periods    from (     select fiscal_period_set_name,fiscal_year_number,count(distinct fiscal_period_name) as no_of_periods       from dw_fiscal_period_d      where adjustment_period_flag = 'N'      group by fiscal_period_set_name,fiscal_year_number    )    group by fiscal_period_set_name ) m2 WHERE m1.fiscal_period_set_name = m2.fiscal_period_set_name   /* Dim Based - Ledger - Month - End */

/* Dim Based - AP BU - Year - Begin */  SELECT         '01'                              AS calendar_type,        'AP BU'                           AS driving_dim_code,         tl.organization_name              AS dimension_value,           TO_CHAR(o.organization_id)        AS dimension_value_code,        'Year'                            AS time_level,        time_seq                          AS time_seq,        time_value                        AS time_value,        time_seq + 1                      AS yago_time_seq   FROM       (SELECT DISTINCT                '01'                              AS calendar_type,                'LEDGER'                          AS driving_dim_code,                l.ledger_name                     AS ledger_name,                 'Year' AS time_level,                    a.fiscal_trailing_year_number     AS time_seq,                TO_CHAR(a.fiscal_year_number)     AS time_value          FROM               dw_fiscal_year_d a,               dw_ledger_d l         WHERE               a.fiscal_trailing_year_number BETWEEN 0 and 19           AND a.fiscal_period_set_name = l.ledger_calender_name       ) x,        dw_internal_org_d o,        dw_internal_org_d_tl tl  WHERE       (o.payables_invoicing_bu_flag = 'Y'           OR o.payables_payment_bu_flag = 'Y' )    AND o.organization_id = tl.organization_id    AND tl.language ='VALUEOF(NQ_SESSION.USER_LANGUAGE_CODE)'    AND o.primary_ledger = x.ledger_name   /* Dim Based - AP BU - Year - End */     UNION ALL  /* Dim Based - AP BU - Quarter - Begin  */  SELECT         '01'                              AS calendar_type,        'AP BU'                           AS driving_dim_code,         tl.organization_name              AS dimension_value,        TO_CHAR(o.organization_id)        AS dimension_value_code,        'Quarter'                         AS time_level,        time_seq                          AS time_seq,        time_value                        AS time_value,        time_seq + 4                      AS yago_time_seq   FROM       (SELECT DISTINCT               l.ledger_name,                fiscal_trailing_quarter_number    AS time_seq,               a.fiscal_quarter_code             AS time_value          FROM              (               SELECT                      fiscal_period_set_name,                      fiscal_period_type,                      current_fiscal_quarter_code,                      fiscal_quarter_code,                      fiscal_quarter_number,                      fiscal_trailing_quarter_number                  FROM                      dw_fiscal_quarter_d               ) a,               dw_ledger_d l         WHERE               a.fiscal_trailing_quarter_number BETWEEN 0 AND 19        AND a.fiscal_period_set_name = l.ledger_calender_name      ) x,       dw_internal_org_d o,       dw_internal_org_d_tl tl WHERE      ( o.payables_invoicing_bu_flag = 'Y'           OR o.payables_payment_bu_flag = 'Y' )       AND o.organization_id = tl.organization_id       AND tl.language = 'VALUEOF(NQ_SESSION.USER_LANGUAGE_CODE)'       AND o.primary_ledger = x.ledger_name    /* Dim Based - AP BU - Quarter - End */   UNION ALL  /* Dim Based - AP BU - Month  */  SELECT         '01'                              AS calendar_type,        'AP BU'                           AS driving_dim_code,         tl.organization_name              AS dimension_value,       TO_CHAR(o.organization_id)        AS dimension_value_code,        'Month'                           AS time_level,        time_seq                          AS time_seq,        time_value                        AS time_value,        time_seq + no_of_periods          AS yago_time_seq   FROM             (       SELECT DISTINCT                l.ledger_name                    ,                a.fiscal_trailing_period_number     AS time_seq,               a.fiscal_period_name                AS time_value,               a.fiscal_period_set_name            AS fiscal_period_set_name           FROM               dw_fiscal_period_d a,               dw_ledger_d   l         WHERE               (a.fiscal_trailing_period_number BETWEEN 0 and 19 OR a.fiscal_trailing_period_number IN (52,53))           AND a.fiscal_period_set_name = l.ledger_calender_name           AND a.adjustment_period_flag = 'N'       ) x,       dw_internal_org_d o,       dw_internal_org_d_tl tl,       (         select fiscal_period_set_name,max(no_of_periods) as no_of_periods            from (             select fiscal_period_set_name,fiscal_year_number,count(distinct fiscal_period_name) as no_of_periods               from dw_fiscal_period_d              where adjustment_period_flag = 'N'              group by fiscal_period_set_name,fiscal_year_number              order by fiscal_period_set_name,fiscal_year_number            )            group by fiscal_period_set_name       ) m2       WHERE      (o.payables_invoicing_bu_flag = 'Y'           OR o.payables_payment_bu_flag = 'Y' )   AND o.organization_id = tl.organization_id   AND tl.language = 'VALUEOF(NQ_SESSION.USER_LANGUAGE_CODE)'   AND o.primary_ledger = x.ledger_name       AND x.fiscal_period_set_name = m2.fiscal_period_set_name  /* Dim Based - AP BU - Month End */

/*  Dim Based - AR BU - Year - Begin */  SELECT         '01'                              AS calendar_type,        'AR BU'                           AS driving_dim_code,         tl.organization_name              AS dimension_value,         TO_CHAR(o.organization_id)        AS dimension_value_code,          'Year'                            AS time_level,        time_seq                          AS time_seq,        time_value                        AS time_value,        time_seq + 1                      AS yago_time_seq   FROM       (SELECT DISTINCT                '01'                              AS calendar_type,                'LEDGER'                          AS driving_dim_code,                l.ledger_name                     AS ledger_name,                 'Year' AS time_level,                    a.fiscal_trailing_year_number     AS time_seq,                TO_CHAR(a.fiscal_year_number)     AS time_value          FROM               dw_fiscal_year_d a,               dw_ledger_d l         WHERE               a.fiscal_trailing_year_number BETWEEN 0 and 19           AND a.fiscal_period_set_name = l.ledger_calender_name       ) x,        dw_internal_org_d o,        dw_internal_org_d_tl tl  WHERE       ( o.BILLING_REVENUE_MNG_BU_FLAG = 'Y'           OR o.CUSTOMER_PAYMENTS_BU_FLAG = 'Y' )    AND o.organization_id = tl.organization_id    AND tl.language = 'VALUEOF(NQ_SESSION.USER_LANGUAGE_CODE)'    AND o.primary_ledger = x.ledger_name  /* Dim Based - AR BU - Year - End */  UNION ALL  /* Dim Based - AR BU - Quarter - Begin */  SELECT         '01'                              AS calendar_type,        'AR BU'                           AS driving_dim_code,         tl.organization_name              AS dimension_value,           TO_CHAR(o.organization_id)        AS dimension_value_code,        'Quarter'                         AS time_level,        time_seq                          AS time_seq,        time_value                        AS time_value,        time_seq + 4                      AS yago_time_seq   FROM       (SELECT DISTINCT               l.ledger_name,                fiscal_trailing_quarter_number    AS time_seq,               a.fiscal_quarter_code             AS time_value          FROM              (               SELECT                      fiscal_period_set_name,                      fiscal_period_type,                      current_fiscal_quarter_code,                      fiscal_quarter_code,                      fiscal_trailing_quarter_number                  FROM                      dw_fiscal_quarter_d               ) a,               dw_ledger_d l         WHERE               a.fiscal_trailing_quarter_number BETWEEN 0 AND 19        AND a.fiscal_period_set_name = l.ledger_calender_name      ) x,       dw_internal_org_d o,       dw_internal_org_d_tl tl WHERE        ( o.BILLING_REVENUE_MNG_BU_FLAG = 'Y'           OR o.CUSTOMER_PAYMENTS_BU_FLAG = 'Y' )       AND o.organization_id = tl.organization_id       AND tl.language = 'VALUEOF(NQ_SESSION.USER_LANGUAGE_CODE)'       AND o.primary_ledger = x.ledger_name     /* Dim Based - AR BU - Quarter - End */  UNION ALL  /* Dim Based - AR BU - Month */  SELECT        '01'                              AS calendar_type,       'AR BU'                           AS driving_dim_code,        tl.organization_name              AS dimension_value,           TO_CHAR(o.organization_id)        AS dimension_value_code,       'Month'                           AS time_level,       time_seq                          AS time_seq,       time_value                        AS time_value,       time_seq + no_of_periods          AS yago_time_seq  FROM            (       SELECT DISTINCT                l.ledger_name                    ,                a.fiscal_trailing_period_number     AS time_seq,               a.fiscal_period_name                AS time_value,               a.fiscal_period_set_name            AS fiscal_period_set_name           FROM               dw_fiscal_period_d a,               dw_ledger_d   l         WHERE               (a.fiscal_trailing_period_number BETWEEN 0 and 19 OR a.fiscal_trailing_period_number IN (52,53))           AND a.fiscal_period_set_name = l.ledger_calender_name           AND a.adjustment_period_flag = 'N'       ) x,        dw_internal_org_d o,        dw_internal_org_d_tl tl,       (         select fiscal_period_set_name,max(no_of_periods) as no_of_periods            from (             select fiscal_period_set_name,fiscal_year_number,count(distinct fiscal_period_name) as no_of_periods               from dw_fiscal_period_d              where adjustment_period_flag = 'N'              group by fiscal_period_set_name,fiscal_year_number              order by fiscal_period_set_name,fiscal_year_number            )            group by fiscal_period_set_name       ) m2         WHERE       ( o.BILLING_REVENUE_MNG_BU_FLAG = 'Y'          OR o.CUSTOMER_PAYMENTS_BU_FLAG = 'Y' )    AND o.organization_id = tl.organization_id    AND tl.language = 'VALUEOF(NQ_SESSION.USER_LANGUAGE_CODE)'    AND o.primary_ledger = x.ledger_name    AND
